'''2005 World Championship Day 2/3 Jared Lockwood LS Local Uprising (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jared Lockwood]] at [[2005 World Championship]] (Day 2/3); the list below is as posted on DeckTech by Jared "JLock" Lockwood (2005-08-24).<ref name="src">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=35103 Jesus Saves (LS Day 2/3)]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20071014025531/http://decktech.net:80/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=35103 Internet Archive]</ref>
